name: google-cloud
description: Google Cloud console tools for Claude: projects, API enable/disable, API keys, IAM, monitoring, logging, billing, BigQuery, Cloud Run, Compute Engine and more. Read-only unless you turn writes on.

allow_writes.title: Allow write tools
allow_writes.description: Expose tools that create or change resources. Delete and disable tools also need confirm=true in each call.

token_dir.title: Token directory (optional)
token_dir.description: Where OAuth tokens are stored. Leave empty for ~/.google-services-mcps.
